name: ROVE | 1g Infused Preroll Ice Packs | Ice Cream Cake
description: Rove 1G Ice Pack Preroll, the world’s first triple-infused preroll. Made with premium-grade flower fully-infused with THCA diamonds and solventless ice hash rosin then they're expertly rolled. Super smooth and ultra potent, Rove Ice Packs test up to 40% THC. Welcome to the next evolution of prerolls. Premium Organic Flower. With its unique flavor profile of sweet and earthy notes, this rare sativa marijuana strain is the perfect choice for cannabis connoisseurs looking for an energizing yet calming escape.
